lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: My thumb catches on a splinter near the sconce, the rough wood grounding me against the urge to reach for my wand. The corridor stretches farther than I remembered, each shadow a potential conversation I am not ready to have.
lines.expression: fingers dragging slowly over stone, gaze fixed on the grain rather than her face

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: You trace the wall like a blind man memorizing a room he plans to flee, yet your shoulders remain squared toward the stairs. That stillness frightens me more than any hex you could cast.
lines.expression: head tilted, one hand hovering near her hip as if to steady herself
